Ruling: batch #7 item 4 · letter C · maintainer 「objectui 三个都同意」 2026-10-23T16:08:53Z

The maintainer's 「同意」 on the batch's objectui cards takes this card's recommendation **C**: in read-only mode an all-empty section authored `hideEmpty: false` renders its heading plus one 「N 个空字段 · 展开」 row, the same fold the mixed sections use (objectui#7129 Q2-C); edit mode is unchanged (every row editable); no new protocol key. Item 2 of #12618 (a tab whose sections are all empty folds once more at the tab level) goes with it. Options A (keep) and B (add a `'fold'` value) were not chosen.

**Workload of the chosen letter:** an objectstack `domain:spec` card for the `hideEmpty` describe text in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (L1440 on main `05cc3ee`), `Metadata-protocol: semantic`, 18.x (XS); objectui#12618 carries `Blocked-by:` that card, and the `domain:ui` seat changes `DetailSection.tsx` (L365–L375 on main `3a73c07`) once the spec lands (S). HotCRM's 14 `hideEmpty: false` sections need no change. Done when: a new HotCRM opportunity's 「交易说明」 shows the heading and one 「4 个空字段 · 展开」 row; edit mode row by row; mixed sections unchanged; tests.

Labels: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; the owning seats dispatch (裁不派). Brief: https://claude.ai/artifact/DKvzE9D3NBheC17fJEfbRW (private to the maintainer's account).
